text: S638 reconciles the latest empirical CLO outcomes and checks current primary-source status/scope for apparel DXF profiles. It separates CLO's documented import/export choices from active standard status, rights, conformance and measured output. No CLO import/export repetition, purchase, supplier contact, geometry edit or gate/hold/status change is authorized by this slice. S637's quarter-ARC trial failed visible button-mark output and stopped before export. See E-G04-S638-START.
